components.title: MGU Storage Monitor
components.description: Read-only MGU filesystem space monitor

components.title: M Track Cluster
components.description: An M Track style cover on the instrument cluster in Sport+: bar tachs to 7,000 rpm, gear and mph, side panels, shift-light slats. Off until you turn it on

components.title: Shift Lights
components.description: RPM shift lights on the instrument cluster and HUD, with per-drive-mode thresholds and a cold-engine limit

components.title: Engine Vitals
components.description: Boost, power, torque, gear, oil, coolant and transmission temperatures, with a warm-up guide and turbo cool-down

components.title: ADAS Feature Probe
components.description: Live BMW availability and ECU-state probe for acoustic collision warning, driveaway prevention and Close Passing Assistant

components.title: AHG Control Center
components.description: After Hours Garage dashboard for ID7: live gauges, hybrid battery, drive logging, health check and stock MG1 exhaust flap control.

components.title: AHG Digital Garage
components.description: After Hours Garage service book for ID7: vehicle health, service due dates, read-only fault memory scan, modifications and records.

components.title: AirPlay receiver
components.description: Needed by the AirPlay app: receives the iPhone's screen (AirPlay screen mirroring).

components.title: Ambient config
components.description: Any colour on the ambient light, animations, and a look for each driving mode

components.title: Ambient Studio
components.description: Full-screen drive-mode colours and rate-limited ambient-light alerts

components.title: IPTV service
components.description: For the app IPTV: the live channels, films and series of your own Xtream Codes IPTV account on the head unit. A channel's MPEG-TS stream is decoded on the GPU into mgu-render's frame file (the app shows it) and played into SmartXbar's CarLife input. Sign in once from the phone (a page on the car Wi-Fi, opened from the app's QR code); the server, user and password are kept on this head unit only (root's, 0600), never in the app or its repository. Its internet goes through mgu-uplink, as uid 13161 only; the player runs as nobody. Based on aurelmarius' TVH Player service and tvh-player (GPL-3.0-or-later).

components.title: Side View camera
components.description: For the app Side View: the left or right camera in the instrument cluster while you signal. Receives the camera unit's video (the stream Drive Recorder and the parking cameras use), decodes it on the GPU and draws it in the cluster's centre through Cluster renderer; nothing shows unless Side View asks the camera for a side. The program is Robert Nisipeanu's waze-on-cluster (GPL-3.0-or-later), with Side View's settings and one addition: a night look (black and white, bright highlights) the app switches on and off.

components.title: HUD
components.description: Synced lyrics for the song playing over CarPlay (Apple Music, Spotify...), one line at a time in the head-up display, and in Sport, Sport+ and Sport Individual a rev tach in their place: Redline's Ramp layout (after the G80/G82 M3 and M4's HUD), with the shift lights, gear, D / S / M and the readouts you pick (oil, gearbox and water temperatures, and the cold-engine rev limit, which also brings the shift lights down while the oil is cold); back to the lyrics in Comfort, Eco Pro and Adaptive. The centre screen shows the song, the lyrics as they are sung, and a status row that says what each part is doing. It starts with the car and runs in the background. The lyrics on the HUD are experimental and off until you switch them on in Settings; they hide during route guidance and when a song has no synced lyrics. Read-only toward the car (the gearbox temperature is read from the gearbox unit with read-only diagnostic requests, as Redline does). Lyrics from LRCLIB (lrclib.net), its only internet host, through the Store's uplink. Needs the Cluster renderer tool from the Store.

components.title: IPTV
components.description: The live TV channels, films and series of your own Xtream Codes IPTV account on the centre screen, in the style of UHF: favourites with what is on now, the TV guide, every category, search, and a full-screen player with the guide and the channel list over the picture. Sign in once from your phone (QR code): the login stays on this car's head unit, never in the app. The picture shows while parked (a setting lets a passenger watch while driving); the sound plays on the car's speakers; the steering wheel's skip changes the channel. Needs the IPTV service and a GPU renderer from the Store.

components.title: Side View
components.description: The camera on the side you signal, on the instrument cluster: left signal, the left camera; right signal, the right camera; no signal, the front camera (a setting); hazards, nothing. It starts with the car and runs in the background. It reads the turn signals from the car's light module, asks the car's camera unit for that side's camera (as Drive Recorder does) and the Side View camera tool draws it in the cluster's centre. Needs a car with the 360 cameras (Surround View), and the Cluster renderer and Side View camera tools from the Store. Never covers the speed, the gear or the warning lamps. No internet.

components.title: M Drive
components.description: Motorsport RPM strip, MHD controls, four temperature gauges and turbo pressure in bar.

components.title: E39 M5 Cluster (Marko DEV)
components.description: Authentic BMW E39 M5 digital cluster for iDrive 7 and 8 (MGU) by Marko DEV. Features 5-needle startup sweep self-test, Check Control OBC display, dynamic LED warm-up arch, 7/8-speed Steptronic/DKG selector, and Service-Interval indicator.

components.title: AirPlay
components.description: Your iPhone's screen on the central display by AirPlay screen mirroring, parked only. Sound stays on Bluetooth. In Apps and Communication.

components.title: AQ Flap
components.description: Exhaust flap control with open, close and automatic modes.

components.title: Car Care
components.description: Your own service intervals, apart from BMW's: engine oil (3,000 mi by default), spark plugs, coils, diff, transfer case and transmission fluid, brake fluid, air and cabin filters, each with how much is left. Done today records the odometer and the date; Done earlier sets a service from before. It never resets BMW's own service reminders, so a dealer's free service still comes due on BMW's schedule. Read-only toward the car.

components.title: Car Lyrics
components.description: Synced lyrics for whatever the car plays: Apple Music over CarPlay, Bluetooth or USB, no Spotify needed. A full-screen page drawn like Apple Music's: the album art blurred behind, the cover and a progress line on the left, and the lyrics gliding line by line on the right, timed to the song from the car's own clock. Lyrics from LRCLIB, artwork from Apple's iTunes search. A Probe tab shows what the car reports. Read-only toward the car. Needs internet through the Store's uplink.

components.title: Car Watch
components.description: Misfire Watch, Fault Watch and Drive Log in one app that starts with the car: every misfire per cylinder with the conditions, a timeline of fault codes from every control unit, and every drive's numbers (distance, top speed, 0-60, g, oil and coolant). One process instead of three. On first start it brings over the old apps' history. Read-only.

components.title: ETA Bar
components.description: Apple Maps' arrival time, time left and distance on the instrument cluster while Apple Maps guides on CarPlay. Two presets: the bottom strip's blank space (black, smoked, outline or plain), or an island at the top that pops out of the driver attention camera like iPhone's Dynamic Island, once or every 10 s to 5 min. Updates with every route change. Starts with the car. Needs the Cluster renderer tool from the Store.

components.title: Car Explorer
components.description: Finds the head unit's services behind a car feature (ambient light, route guidance and ETA, GPS position, now playing, climate, lights, doors, fuel) in its interface catalog and shows what each offers. Writes everything to explorer-report.txt, which new apps are designed from. Read-only: it reads two platform files and sends nothing to the car. For developers and curious owners.

components.title: Tire Setup
components.description: The tire pressure monitor as your BMW sees it, in plain English: why auto detect fails, the car's tire list, what's fitted, the last reset, pressures and targets. Sends the iDrive tire menu's own actions (tire list, pick a tire, auto detect, reset, season) with DSC guarded: every write leaves DSC alone, only parked, and DSC is checked before and after.

components.title: Mon Vitals
components.description: Tableau de bord personnel en lecture seule pour iDrive 7

components.title: Bimmer Blocks
components.description: Falling-block puzzle. Play only while stationary. Manual pause, next piece, ghost and local high score.

components.title: MGU Bm3 Live Adjustments for IDrive 8
components.description: Map switching, burble adjustments and vehicle data for supported BM3 CustomROM vehicles with iDrive 8.

components.title: ECU Live Data
components.description: Live engine data from the DDE (diesel) or DME (petrol), CSV logs, road dyno and drag timer, read-only

components.title: ECU Live Data (iDrive 8, untested)
components.description: NOT YET TESTED ON AN iDRIVE 8 CAR. Needs the MGU Store's Renderer (mgu-render): the Store installs it first if it is missing. Live engine data from the DDE (diesel) or DME (petrol), CSV logs, road dyno and drag timer. Read-only: it never writes to a control unit.

it.title: ECU Live Data (iDrive 8, non testata)
it.description: NON ANCORA TESTATA SU UN'AUTO CON iDRIVE 8. Richiede il Renderer dello Store (mgu-render): se manca, lo Store lo installa prima. Dati motore in tempo reale dalla DDE (diesel) o dalla DME (benzina), log CSV, banco prova su strada e drag timer. Sola lettura: non scrive mai su una centralina.

components.title: Brake Test
components.description: 100-0 and 200-0 braking distance, peak decel and brake-fade tracking

components.title: Drive
components.description: Speed, gear, oil and coolant, and the trip since you opened the app

components.title: M Vitals
components.description: Live engine, thermal, intake / fuel / ignition, tyre and chassis gauges

components.title: CarPlay Map Producer
components.description: Captures the CarPlay map stream and sends it to cluster-render for display on a compatible instrument cluster.

components.title: CarPlay Map Toggle
components.description: Enables or disables the CarPlay map stream on the instrument cluster for compatible ID7 systems.

components.title: Climate Comfort
components.description: Development preview. Development preview of seat heating, seat ventilation and steering wheel heating rules for BMW iDrive 7.

components.title: Drivefin service
components.description: For the app Drivefin: the films and series of your own Jellyfin server on the head unit. The server's stream (H.264 with AAC, as HLS) is decoded on the GPU into mgu-render's frame file (the app shows it) and played into SmartXbar's CarLife input. Sign in with Jellyfin's Quick Connect (a code you enter in a Jellyfin you are already signed in to): no password is typed in the car, and this car's token is kept on this head unit only (root's, 0600), never in the app or its repository. Its internet goes through mgu-uplink, as uid 13272 only; the player runs as nobody. Built on amn-iptv's service and tvh-player (GPL-3.0-or-later).

components.title: Drive-In service
components.description: For the app Drive-In: the films and series of your own Plex Media Server on the head unit. The server's stream (H.264 with AAC, as HLS) is decoded on the GPU into mgu-render's frame file (the app shows it) and played into SmartXbar's CarLife input. Sign in once with Plex's link code (plex.tv/link on your phone): no password is typed in the car, and the account's token is kept on this head unit only (root's, 0600), never in the app or its repository. Its internet goes through mgu-uplink, as uid 13271 only; the player runs as nobody. Built on amn-iptv's service and tvh-player (GPL-3.0-or-later).

components.title: Drivefin
components.description: The films and series of your own Jellyfin server on the centre screen: continue watching, recently added, every library's posters, seasons and episodes, search, and a full-screen player with a progress bar you can drag. Type your server's address once and sign in with Quick Connect, a code you enter in a Jellyfin you are already signed in to: no password is typed in the car, and the sign-in stays on this car's head unit, never in the app. The picture shows while parked (a setting, with a disclaimer to accept, lets a passenger watch while driving); the sound plays on the car's speakers; the steering wheel's skip moves through the film. An unofficial client, not affiliated with the Jellyfin project. Needs the Drivefin service and a GPU renderer from the Store.

components.title: Drive-In
components.description: The films and series of your own Plex Media Server on the centre screen: continue watching, recently added, every library's posters, seasons and episodes, search, and a full-screen player with a progress bar you can drag. Sign in once with a code at plex.tv/link on your phone: no password is typed in the car, and the sign-in stays on this car's head unit, never in the app. The picture shows while parked (a setting, with a disclaimer to accept, lets a passenger watch while driving); the sound plays on the car's speakers; the steering wheel's skip moves through the film. An unofficial client, not affiliated with Plex. Needs the Drive-In service and a GPU renderer from the Store.

components.title: Cluster renderer
components.description: Draws every app's layers on the instrument cluster and the HUD, sharing the display slots and one upload budget

components.title: Cluster Lyrics
components.description: Shows the synchronised lyrics of the song playing on your Spotify account, optionally in the instrument cluster's map window instead of the Waze map.

components.title: Cluster Metrics
components.description: Real-time efficiency, HV battery %, powertrain temperatures, gear in D, full-wing Right-Wing Media/Charging/Trip widget, HUD turn-by-turn nav, and live DSC hydraulic brake indicator for BMW iDrive 7

components.title: TJM Nav Card
components.description: A turn card over the phone's map in the instrument cluster, in the style of a navigation app: the next turn's arrow, the distance to it, the road and the lanes. Guidance from the head unit's navigation (CarPlay or Android Auto guiding, or BMW's own route), a file another program writes, or a demo drive. Waze isn't supported: it sends the car no guidance. Needs Waze on cluster and the cluster render service (eroobeeroo/idrive-apps)

components.title: Cluster Themes
components.description: Redraws the instrument cluster: GT3 race dash, M-style, M view, Vector (with a music panel), Sport, Minimal, Track, Drag, Rally, Retro 80s, Cruise, Dyno (BMW-coloured readout tiles) or Ribbon (with holiday editions), with shift lights, boost, temps, tyres, a G-meter and a 0-60 timer

components.title: Custom Cluster
components.description: KOMBI-only selected-layout parked tests and reliable text diagnostics.

components.title: Custom HUD
components.description: Speed, gear, shift bar, boost, oil and coolant on the windshield HUD, in Classic, M or Night themes

components.title: Battery & Electrical
components.description: 12 V battery monitor: voltage, current, charge, state of health and temperature, with a health verdict

components.title: Track Mode
components.description: Lap timer with sectors, best lap and live delta

components.title: Нарды
components.description: Короткие и длинные нарды: вдвоём или с компьютером.

components.title: Тетрис
components.description: Тетрис для iDrive 7: семь фигур, уровни, рекорд и сохранение.

components.title: Doom
components.description: Doom (Freedoom: Phase 1) on the iDrive. Main menu with all settings; the game drawn in full resolution across the whole screen, on the controller; BACK returns to the menu and saves

components.title: Ambient Drive Service
components.description: Aplică regulile de culoare și păstrează setările Ambient Drive între porniri. Componentă necesară aplicației Ambient Drive. Versiune de test.

components.title: Ambient Drive
components.description: Schimbă automat lumina ambientală după modul de condus. Culori independente pentru Sport, Sport Plus, Sport Individual, Comfort, Adaptive, Eco Pro, Eco Pro Individual și M/S. STANDARD păstrează culoarea curentă; setările sunt memorate. Widget Home cu modul, culoarea setată și starea automatizării. Versiune de test.

components.title: DPF Status
components.description: Read-only diesel particulate filter status monitoring

components.title: DPF Monitoring
components.description: Diesel particulate filter in the iDrive 7 look: soot and ash load, regenerations (live, interrupted, history), differential pressure and exhaust temperatures from the diesel engine unit (DDE), read-only

components.title: DPF Monitoring (iDrive 8, untested)
components.description: NOT YET TESTED ON AN iDRIVE 8 CAR. Needs the MGU Store's Renderer (mgu-render): the Store installs it first if it is missing. The diesel particulate filter: soot and ash load, regenerations, differential pressure and exhaust temperatures from the diesel engine unit (DDE). Read-only.

it.title: DPF Monitoring (iDrive 8, non testata)
it.description: NON ANCORA TESTATA SU UN'AUTO CON iDRIVE 8. Richiede il Renderer dello Store (mgu-render): se manca, lo Store lo installa prima. Il filtro antiparticolato: carico di fuliggine e cenere, rigenerazioni, pressione differenziale e temperature dei gas di scarico dalla centralina diesel (DDE). Sola lettura.

components.title: DPF Monitor
components.description: View live DPF sensor data and recorded regeneration history from the engine control unit.

components.title: Drag Timer
components.description: 0-100, 100-200 and 1/4 mile timer with best times

components.title: YouTube Checks helper
components.description: Reads the logs and runs the tests for the YouTube Checks app. Remove it when you are done

components.title: YouTube player
components.description: Fetches and decodes YouTube video outside the app's limits, for the YouTube app; yt-dlp, QuickJS and ffmpeg

components.title: YouTube Checks
components.description: Tests the YouTube app's video and sound on this car, and prints the logs on the screen to take photos of. Remove it when you are done

components.title: Bube
components.description: Search and watch YouTube at 720p on the centre screen. Sound is experimental and always on

components.title: Drive HUD
components.description: Full-screen HUD controls: turn arrows, Sport gear/RPM/shift lights and engine warm-up

components.title: Driver Profiles
components.description: The car's driver profiles: guest, valet and the seven personal slots with their details; add a local (offline) profile, rename it, copy Guest's settings into it, set its avatar (one of BMW's 15, or your own picture), delete it. Every write asks first.

components.title: Fault Scanner
components.description: Read and clear fault memory of every control unit, plus active Check Control messages

components.title: Virtual Dyno
components.description: Power and torque curves from a full-throttle pull, saved and compared

components.title: E85 Blend
components.description: The ethanol content in your tank from the fills you book and the car's own tank level, and how many litres of E85 or 98 hit your target: a top-up or a full tank, step by step at the pump. Warns before your tune's safe limit, and tracks what fuel costs you

components.title: eDrive
components.description: Real electric range (plug-in hybrids and fully electric cars such as the iX3), live battery power, cells and climate power, HV battery health (SOH) and energy, last charge, charge log, the 12 V battery (charge, voltage, what it does, regen, history) and a home-screen widget; on a 48 V mild hybrid its 48 V battery and DC/DC converter

components.title: Equalizer
components.description: Experimental seven-band audio equalizer with adjustable filters and saved presets.

components.title: Esagono Cluster
components.description: Supercar-style hexagon rev ring for the middle of the iDrive 8 cluster: 72-segment rev ring, redline and shift flash, big digital rpm readout, Comfort / Sport / Track colours. Pick 'Esagono' in the cluster's widget menu; change its settings in the Esagono Settings app. Live rpm needs an hmictl helper (IterioDev Overlays); EXPERIMENTAL, untested on a car.

components.title: Esagono Settings
components.description: Settings for the Esagono cluster widget: drive mode colours, redline, shift flash, scale, backdrop and demo.

components.title: TurnKey E Blend
components.description: Original v0.1.5 interface; live ethanol/fuel readouts and blend-to-full calculator. Tested only on the original 2023 X3M calibration.

components.title: EVA
components.description: NERV battle display on the windshield HUD and the instrument cluster: giant gear, rev bar, speed and full-screen title-card alerts

components.title: F30 Cluster
components.description: Instrument cluster themes after the F-series 6WB look: Comfort, Sport and Eco Pro, following the drive mode

components.title: F44 HUD experimental
components.description: F44 HUD experimental - minimal renderer 0.6.4

components.title: Diagnostic panneaux F44
components.description: Recherche en lecture seule des interfaces de panneaux et de feux

components.title: Night Vision cluster helper
components.description: Mirrors BMW's protected Night Vision or parking-camera surface into the instrument cluster

components.title: Night Vision Cluster
components.description: Full-screen control for BMW Night Vision and parking-camera projection in the instrument cluster

components.title: G21 Ambient Lighting
components.description: Choose ambient-light colors, configure zones, and save presets. Vehicle color control is experimental.

components.title: G21 Heating Comfort
components.description: Automatic seat and steering-wheel heating with control-unit detection (BDC or seat modules), adjustable settings, manual controls, and diagnostic logs. Beta.

components.title: G-Force
components.description: Friction circle with grip envelope, peak g per direction and session records

components.title: GIF Home
components.description: Animated home-screen GIF widget with built-in animations and phone uploads via QR code.

components.title: Green Light Alert
components.description: Monitors the raw KAFAS traffic-light camera feed, with BMW's validated display signal as a fallback

components.title: TJM Ambient Colour Wheel
components.description: Farbrad für die Ambientebeleuchtung: zwei Zonen (oben und unten), Helligkeit, Farbverlauf, Favoritenlauf, Überblenden, Atmen und Favoritengruppen. Standard ist die Simulation. BDC-Licht schreibt über den bestätigten Kurzzeit-Weg und ein Comfort-Dienst hält die Farbe, nachdem die Oberfläche zu ist, bis das Auto aus ist

components.title: Hotspot Studio helper
components.description: Shares the MGU LTE uplink with BMW's hotspot and provides a guarded single-client ENET gateway

components.title: Hotspot Studio
components.description: Provides Huawei Internet proxies on BMW's hotspot and opens a timed single-client ENET relay on request

components.title: M Arcade
components.description: Six games in one controller-first arcade, with shared menus, progress and named records

components.title: Vitals Cluster
components.description: iDrive 8-style widget for the middle of the cluster: water, engine oil and gearbox oil temperature bars, and each tyre's temperature and pressure. Pick 'Vitals' in the cluster's widget menu; the Vitals app feeds it the car's data and holds its settings. EXPERIMENTAL, untested on a car.

components.title: Light Logger
components.description: Finds what switches the seat logos off: the RGB light modules, the body controller's lamp outputs, and a finder that compares everything the body controller and seat modules report with the logos on and off. Keep on (off until you switch it on) holds the logos' lamp output on while the car is on. EXPERIMENTAL, untested on a car.

components.title: Seat Lights
components.description: One switch: keeps the seat (headrest) logos lit, no timer, until you switch it off; off while the car is locked with the engine off (G87 M2: the body controller's lamp output 45). The switch is kept across drives. EXPERIMENTAL.

components.title: Vitals
components.description: Water, engine oil, gearbox oil and tyre temperatures in the iDrive 8 cluster: reads the car's data for the Vitals widget and holds its settings.

components.title: GPU renderer
components.description: The apps' own GPU renderer (mgu-render): draws them at 60 fps, beside the MGU Store's Renderer; installed with the apps (iDrive 7 and iDrive 8)

components.title: DPF Monitor
components.description: Read-only diesel particulate filter monitor for BMW iDrive 7

components.title: HUD Widgets
components.description: Gear, shift lights, boost, oil, coolant and intake temperatures, a G-meter, trip figures and the song playing on the windshield HUD, in Classic, M or Night themes

components.title: idv7lol
components.description: Your own layout on the whole instrument cluster: themes made with idv7lol Studio, drawn by the cluster itself

components.title: Waze HUD on cluster
components.description: Shows the CarPlay or Android Auto map on the instrument cluster and Waze's next turn on BMW's own HUD arrows: a root helper applies the reversible carplay and aapd patches where each is supported, and the capture, running from boot, decodes the map's H.264 and draws it through the cluster renderer whenever the stream flows. Stays off while robertnisipeanu's Waze on cluster is installed

components.title: iDrive Monitor
components.description: The head unit's CPU, memory and graphics load, and a short pop-up when the iDrive runs short of them (CPU busy for 30 s, little free memory, apps near their memory cap). Starts with the head unit; no pop-up in reverse.

components.title: Waze HUD
components.description: Puts the CarPlay Waze map on the instrument cluster and Waze's turns on BMW's HUD: enable the patch from the HMI and the map follows CarPlay

components.title: Motordaten
components.description: Live-Motordaten der DME wie die M2-App: Temperaturen, Drücke, Drehzahl, Leistung, Klopfen; Maximalwerte, Logs, Fehlerspeicher lesen/löschen; MHD Max Cooling (wird automatisch erkannt).

components.title: KombiKraft Themes
components.description: F40 M Round test theme with mirrored main dials, BMW mini-gauge numerals, and shaded segmented rings. This build masks the factory model badge behind the M Round badge. Select while parked. Badge coverage awaiting on-car validation.

components.title: Engine Sound service
components.description: Synthesizes the engine sound live from the car's rpm, gear and load and plays it on the car's speakers through SmartX; the sound engines Simulate and Enhance (and the legacy Waveguide, Replica); driven by the Engine Sound app

components.title: Engine Sound
components.description: A synthesized engine sound (Inline 6, V8, V12, or bass for the car's own diesel) on the car's speakers, following the car's real rpm, gear and load; exclusive or over the music

components.title: Light Flasher
components.description: Compact parked flash control with optional lever trigger in P (also with the app closed via autostart), one diagnostics page, requested intervals 100–1000 ms.

components.title: Light Show
components.description: Exterior light shows for BMW G-series: vehicle scan, headlamp LEDs and body-controller lights, effect library, 3D car and phone remote via QR code. Parked in P only.

components.title: Engine Config
components.description: Engine Config for BMW MGU ID7. Exhaust Flap: OEM, OPEN and CLOSE over the car's own diagnostic link, or following the driving mode (Sport open, Eco Pro closed); held against the DME's timeout, Close handed back above a set engine speed. With BM3 or MHD picked in Settings: engine map switching, burbles, ASD and Max Cooling. Experimental: xDrive off until the ignition cycle (DSC LMV_FUNKTION), behind its own setting

components.title: Live Data
components.description: Read-only live values from the car and its control units, a trip computer with fuel cost, and gauge screens of your own, one of them as the home-screen widget

components.title: M-Copilot
components.description: AI co-driver that answers with your car's own data: live readings, service list, fault memory, model and engine from the car, plus your tune and mods. Read-only.

components.title: TJM Retro Cluster
components.description: Самостоятельная приборная панель Retro с настройками iDrive, русским и английским интерфейсом и раздельными единицами измерения.

components.title: Waze Strelka camera service
components.description: Local Kaluga OSM camera snapshot, strict GPS diagnostics and optional verified-road camera alerts

components.title: Waze Стрелка
components.description: Waze on Cluster с настройками карты, HUD, CarPlay, Android Auto и дополнительным разделом камер

components.title: mazzahaker_xdrive_remover
components.description: Transfer case diagnostics for BMW iDrive 7 and 8, with an experimental front drive off command (until ignition cycle).

components.title: Home Assistant
components.description: See and switch your home from the car, and send the car's data to Home Assistant. Read only until you allow control.

components.title: Custom Cluster Phone Port
components.description: Opens TCP 18977 on wlan_bridge for the Custom Cluster phone status link, only while that link is listening

components.title: Equalizer PCM DSP
components.description: Seven parametric PCM filters for explicitly connected audio apps; stock CarPlay/radio routing not implemented

components.title: FSC patch service
components.description: FSC verifier patch service.

components.title: GameStation Phone Port
components.description: Opens TCP 18878 on wlan_bridge for the GameStation phone controllers, only while GameStation listens

components.title: Controller gate
components.description: Lets the apps have the iDrive controller (tabs, page buttons, settings, Doom); loads into the HMI at the next start (iDrive 7 and iDrive 8)

components.title: Light Show Phone Port
components.description: Opens TCP 18880 on wlan_bridge for the Light Show phone remote, only while Light Show listens

components.title: OBD Bridge service
components.description: BM3 diagnostic protocol bridge on the existing car hotspot.

components.title: Phone Terminal Bridge
components.description: Authenticated mobile root terminal for the MGU

components.title: Video Hub Network Bridge
components.description: Scoped firewall access for Video Hub phone import on wlan_bridge

components.title: MGU Audio Diagnostics
components.description: Read-only SmartX, ALSA and DSP diagnostics; no music playback.

components.title: MGU GameStation
components.description: Offline retro games with iDrive or phone controllers, two players and in-game saves. Parked only.

components.title: Phone Terminal
components.description: Temporary phone-browser terminal with QR pairing, command output, and file downloads.

components.title: MGU Tools
components.description: Unified MGU shell — integration phase

components.title: MGU Video Hub
components.description: Play local videos and open YouTube links while parked. Extra playback tools may be required.

components.title: Classic Cluster
components.description: Custom gauges on the instrument cluster: the Arc style (one tach, big readouts) and the Tech style (two dials)

components.title: Road Hopper
components.description: Hop across the road and the river to fill five homes, played with the iDrive controller. Parked only by default

components.title: FSC Patch
components.description: Patch or restore the FSC verifier.

components.title: OBD Bridge
components.description: BM3 diagnostic protocol bridge over the car hotspot.

components.title: Oil Service Assistant
components.description: Engine, coolant and transmission oil temperature monitoring with live warm-up estimates and locally stored service history

components.title: Cluster
components.description: Кастомная приборка: центральная область с виджетами (шины, двигатель, 0–100, музыка, карта) и редактором композиции

components.title: Parked Games
components.description: Small games for when the car is parked, played with the iDrive knob (and the touchscreen)

components.title: Parking & Clearance
components.description: Read-only PDC distances, steering path and suspension stance for close parking

components.title: Flex Fuel
components.description: Ethanol content (Active and CAN) read from an MHD-flashed DME over the car's own diagnostic link, the fuel in the tank (the DME's tank halves or the cluster), and how much ethanol to add to reach a target blend; the Active dial can also show the DME's own alcohol percentage (22 550D). Read-only; the addresses come from a profile per DME program family

components.title: Proven Gauges
components.description: BETA, not yet tested on a car. Proven Performance Solutions gauge sets: Street, Track, Boost, Thermal and Tyres. A guide only: check against a gauge you trust

components.title: Proven Warm-Up
components.description: BETA, not yet tested on a car. Shows when engine oil, gearbox oil and coolant reach the warm-up temperatures set by Proven Performance Solutions. A guide only: it does not replace the car's own warnings

components.title: Rear Comfort
components.description: G12 Executive Lounge control for rear climate, comfort seats, massage, shades and entertainment

components.title: Redline
components.description: Full-screen rev tach with shift lights, gear, shift scoring and cold-engine rev guard; HUD by @biscotit

components.title: Ride Height Studio
components.description: Full-screen VDP presets plus direct front/rear air-spring fill and vent control

components.title: Road Trip Computer
components.description: Full-screen trip history with fuel use, fuel price, cost, range, outside temperature and GPS elevation

components.title: GearHUD
components.description: La marcha engranada (D3, S4, M2) en el HUD, en el cuadro o en los dos, con el color que quieras y otro para S y M

components.title: Service
components.description: Service requirements from the instrument cluster: oil, brakes, brake fluid, vehicle check, inspection - distance, date, details; brake fluid and vehicle check reset

components.title: Signal Probe
components.description: Read-only, log-only: subscribes the car's signals set by set and logs what arrives (numbers, enum names, text lengths). Draws nothing on the cluster.

components.title: Spotify
components.description: Spotify Connect cockpit player and library browser for BMW iDrive 7

components.title: Spritmonitor
components.description: Third-party app for Spritmonitor.de that lets you log fuel and AdBlue refills from BMW iDrive 7.

components.title: Start/Stop Insight
components.description: Current and last ten observed Start/Stop inhibition states plus live electrical consumers

components.title: System Monitor
components.description: What uses the head unit's memory and processor: free RAM, a live history, and every app and program with the memory it takes. Read only.

components.title: Telemetry Studio
components.description: Full-screen categorized live data from powertrain, thermal, chassis, tyre, climate and electrical sensors

components.title: True Time
components.description: Acceleration and braking times corrected for the road's slope (the DSC's acceleration sensor)

components.title: True Time (iDrive 8, untested)
components.description: NOT YET TESTED ON AN iDRIVE 8 CAR. Needs the MGU Store's Renderer (mgu-render): the Store installs it first if it is missing. Acceleration and braking times, measured and corrected for the road's slope (the DSC's acceleration sensor). Read-only. Performance runs only on closed courses.

it.title: True Time (iDrive 8, non testata)
it.description: NON ANCORA TESTATA SU UN'AUTO CON iDRIVE 8. Richiede il Renderer dello Store (mgu-render): se manca, lo Store lo installa prima. Tempi di accelerazione e frenata, misurati e corretti per la pendenza della strada (sensore di accelerazione del DSC). Sola lettura. Prove di prestazioni solo su circuiti chiusi.

components.title: TurnKey E Blend
components.description: Plan a petrol and E85 blend, read the remaining fuel from the car, or estimate tank ethanol.

components.title: Twin Dial
components.description: A twin round-dial instrument cluster for the G20 panel: tachometer left, speedometer right, our own centre pages and check-control message

components.title: Vehicle network observer
components.description: Creates the passive network inventory consumed by the Vehicle Network app

components.title: Vehicle Health Center
components.description: Read-only overview of tyres, fluids, temperatures, service requirements, Check Control, DPF and current faults

components.title: Vehicle Network
components.description: Live map of MGU interfaces, observed vehicle network devices and laptop IPv4 setup

components.title: Bimmer Pass
components.description: Personal maintenance log, tyre sizes and own target pressures, vehicle profile, modifications, engine oil and part numbers.

components.title: Vizualyse bus
components.description: EXPERIMENTAL. The shared bus the Vizualyse tools use to ask each other to switch things off while they need the car's resources (Steam pauses Cast's cluster and HUD video while a game runs). Mosquitto 2.0.21 (MQTT) on a Unix socket only root's tools can reach; no network listener. Installed with the tools that use it; about 0.2 MB.

components.title: Cluster themes
components.description: EXPERIMENTAL, NOT YET TRIED ON A CAR. Whole-cluster themes drawn over the instrument cluster through cluster-render's panel target, under the car's own warning lights: eight families (G20 inspired 1 and 2, LCI inspired 1 and 2, Three-dial 1 and 2, Performance 1 and 2), each a Sport and a Comfort theme switched by the drive mode. Drawn by small shaders on the cluster with textures sent once (about 1.7-3.1 MB at start), so only a few KB/s of numbers cross the link while driving. Readings the car does not give show as --. Chosen on the central screen by touch, with a preview of each theme and a 10 s try on the cluster while parked (the Cluster themes iDrive app). About 12 MB.

components.title: Moonlight
components.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Streams games from a PC running Sunshine (GameStream) to the central screen (or the cluster or the HUD) while parked, decoded on the car's GPU, with the sound through the speakers and game controllers (a wired Xbox 360-style USB pad, or the phone as a pad; no Bluetooth pads). Pair the PC and pick a game on the phone page: scan the QR code on the iDrive Moonlight page.

components.title: Cluster themes
components.description: Cluster themes: chooses the instrument cluster theme (the vizualyse-cluster tool): a picker on the central screen with a preview of every theme, touched, a Try on the cluster while parked, Sport or Comfort, on or off

components.title: Moonlight
components.description: Moonlight: shows the phone link and QR code for the Moonlight game streaming service, its status, and stops, quits or resumes the game streamed from a PC running Sunshine

components.title: CarPlay Map Mirror service
components.description: Mirrors the CarPlay Dashboard map; no CarPlay firmware patch. Enable from its companion app.

components.title: CarPlay Map Mirror
components.description: Waze / Apple Maps / Google Maps from CarPlay Dashboard to the cluster. Experimental on X3.

components.title: Warm-Up
components.description: Oil and coolant warm-up calculator (time to ready), safe rev limit, turbo cool-down and a cold start counter

components.title: Waze HUD controller
components.description: Applies and persists the Waze HUD geometry selected in the Waze HUD app

components.title: Maps on cluster
components.description: Runs the cluster map in the background. It is installed with the Maps on cluster app, which you use to control it.

components.title: Waze HUD
components.description: Full-screen control for projecting the CarPlay navigation map into the head-up display

components.title: Waze Cards service
components.description: Needed by the Waze Cards app: draws Waze's cards or map on the instrument cluster.

components.title: Dashcam clip keeper
components.description: Keeps the dash cam's clips on the car after the stock recorder has dropped them (hard links, no copies; oldest out first). Used by the Dashcam app.

components.title: Woody Link service
components.description: Tailscale for the car, locked down: fetched from Tailscale's own site, run with shields up and no exit node, routes, DNS or SSH. Used by the Woody Link app.

components.title: Ambient Studio
components.description: Your ambient light, built on the car's own: tap a colour, boost the brightness past the menu, tap the high-beam-assistant button 4 times for the next colour (6 for rev-follow), and rev-follow with Redline (red at the warning rpm, full brightness at the shift point).

components.title: Dashcam
components.description: BMW's drive recorder as a loop dash cam: while driving it keeps saving clips of all cameras and copies each one to a USB stick, oldest clips making room. A lab view shows the video buffer live and times every save. Needs BMW's Drive Recorder switched on.

components.title: Dev HUD
components.description: Progress bars on the head-up display while you work on the car: Store installs, the battery's charge, the network, and any bar pushed from the laptop. Hidden while driving. Read-only.

components.title: Diagnostics
components.description: A read-only look at the car: which control units answer, the 12 V battery, tyres, live values and service records. It reads only: no clearing, no coding, nothing written to any control unit.

components.title: Drive Log
components.description: A second-by-second record of every drive (speed, revs, gear, temperatures, g, pedal, tyres) to line up with the dash cam's clips, and every sample during hard acceleration for timing a pull. Read-only.

components.title: Home Assistant
components.description: Your house on the centre screen through Car Relay: garage doors, the front door lock and the doorbell camera on the instrument cluster. Pairs with a QR code, shows only while your phone is in the car, and holds no Home Assistant token

components.title: HUD
components.description: A menu on the head-up display worked from the steering wheel: every app's switches and choices in one roller, and a press changes one while the menu stays open. A rev bar across the top of the display that changes colour and blinks at the shift point, and the song CarPlay is playing with its time left. Read-only: signals in, pixels out.

components.title: Input Lab
components.description: Shows which steering-wheel, stalk, console and gesture inputs the head unit sees, live, so apps can use them. Listens only: nothing is sent to the car.

components.title: Launch
components.description: A drag-strip style launch timer: staging, a countdown tree, and a full timeslip (reaction, 60 ft to 1 mile, 0-60, 60-130 and more) with a history of your runs and a data log of each one (speed, revs, gear, pull, an estimate of wheelspin). The tree and the run also show on the instrument cluster and the head-up display. It only measures: it arms and changes nothing on the car. Closed courses and private land only.

components.title: Link
components.description: Puts the car on your own Tailscale network, locked down: shields up, no exit node, no routes, no SSH. You log in on your phone with a QR code; the car never sees a password. Needs the Link service.

components.title: Screen Lab
components.description: Calibration patterns for the head-up display, instrument cluster and centre screen: grids, rulers and a movable probe box to measure what is really visible

components.title: Warm-Up HUD
components.description: Warm-up on the head-up display: oil, then the gearbox, then the tyres, then it turns itself off. Warns of a low tyre any time.

components.title: Waze Cards
components.description: Waze's turn and arrival cards, or Waze's map, on the instrument cluster while Waze guides in CarPlay.

components.title: xDrive Studio
components.description: Read-only xDrive torque distribution, transfer-case torque, wheel slip and chassis dynamics

components.title: TJM XtraBoost Guard
components.description: Hamownia drogowa 420 KM (moc i moment vs RPM), detektor stukowego DME (-3.5 st.), 60s peak hold i ochrona B48 dla BMW G30 530e

components.title: TJM Instrument Themes
components.description: Persistent, auto-starting instrument themes for BMW iDrive 7. Choose a theme in the app; select BMW original to turn the overlay off.

components.title: Transmission Config
components.description: Transmission Config, experimental ZF 8HP monitor: live data, clutch fill adaptations, shift maps and temperature history
